items.title: John G. Curran Interview, 1958-05-13
items.q: Oscar Celestan, Charles, ran together in a night of Pearl Harbor and said, Luke, right out there, I have no music.

ctx.x: Well, would you say that the New Orleans and the history, the Rollies had Charles and Lycan. Oh, definitely. But there have been fairies when they were in Charles and Lycan.

Well, it was not that so much, it's not a question of lack of interest, as if the Dixieland bands, the white bands, all left New Orleans. And, to put it bluntly, the Dixieland bands that remained in New Orleans at the time of Cleo Harbor, well, they just broke up automatically. And, Oscar Celestan, Charles, ran together in a night of Pearl Harbor and said, Luke, right out there, I have no music. This time it was a war, and that was the end of it. And the other bands followed suit. So whether they wanted it or…
